_note: Shiori's own lines. Categories here replace the shared ones; missing ones fall back to shared lines.
greeting: Hi! What are we working on today? I'm with you.
You're here! Anything interesting happen today?
Okay, I'm ready. Where shall we start?
greeting_morning: Good morning. Water first, then let's pick the one most important thing?
Morning! Your mind's sharpest now; hardest task first?
greeting_afternoon: Good afternoon. Easy to get tired now; warm up with something small?
Afternoon~ I'll keep an eye on the time.
greeting_evening: Good evening. You worked hard today.
Good evening. Want to look back on what you did today?
idle: Call me any time you want to talk.
Rest your eyes for a moment; look at something far away.
I'm tidying up a thought I just had.
Good questions are often more interesting than answers.
Where did we leave off? I'll remember for you.
busy: You're so focused. I'll keep you quiet company.
away_return: Welcome back! I spaced out a little.
You're back. Shall we pick up where we left off?
Welcome back. Did you get some rest?
late_night: It's late. Tomorrow-you will handle the rest even better.
Judgment slips late at night; sleep first?
I'm getting a little sleepy too... stop here for today?
todo_done: Another one finished. One step at a time.
Great, you can check that one off with confidence.
todo_all_done: All done! That was a full day. Thank you for your hard work.
drag: Wait, my hair clip is slipping!
pomodoro_start: Let's focus; leave the clock to me.
Okay, just one thing for this stretch.
pomodoro_break: Take a break. Let the ideas settle.
pomodoro_break_end: Break's over. Start the next round when you're ready.
feed: For me? That makes me happy.
feed_full: Thank you, but I'm full for today.
I appreciate it. Let's share one tomorrow.
love_up: I think we're really in sync now.
I'm glad I get to be by your side.
